Method of Attack: Infecting smart water irrigation systems to assemble botnets that cause mass water consumption
Exploiting vulnerabilities in smart water irrigation systems to trigger mass water resource consumption
Using infected devices on the same LAN as irrigation systems as relay points for scanning and exploitation
Renting DDoS-for-hire botnets to scan and exploit smart irrigation systems on local networks
Malvertising to relay malicious code to internal LANs
Discoverer: Ben Nassi and team from Ben-Gurion University of the Negev (BGU)
Impacted Systems: Smart water irrigation systems from vendors BlueSpray, GreenIQ, RainMachine
Local routers, computers, WiFi hotspots, other IoT devices on the same LAN
Attack Vector: Local network devices as relay points
